Class DynamicGestureDefinition

java.lang.Object
aslframework.model.GestureDefinition
aslframework.model.DynamicGestureDefinition
public class DynamicGestureDefinition extends GestureDefinition
Represents a dynamic ASL gesture defined by a sequence of hand poses over time. Used for motion-based letters such as J and Z.
